duration_definition: For each vertex sum the subset of tau1,tau2,tau3 lying strictly between its first and second incident insertion; no equal-time substitution. All midpoint durations are listed, with zero as adverse/control support.
box_derivative_requirement: Optional exact-g first-moment upper cap; absent it, global functional-calculus sup(x exp(-t x)) <= 1/(2t) for x>=charged floor>0, plus contraction difference <=1 at t=0. This bounds all endpoint entries, not a moment heat proxy.
infinite_tail: Outside cube union tau_j>T: L1-hop-product times exp[-sum_j(64*j+ncharged_j*c+z)tau_j]. Integrated union bound explicit; ncharged2=4 for opposite edges, otherwise2. c=-5120-E0upper.
kernel_convention: Gplus[q,p]=<g,c_q exp[-t(H257,-1/2-E0)] c_pdagger g>; Gminus[q,p]=<g,c_pdagger exp[-t(H255,+1/2-E0)] c_q g>. Both have row annihilation index q and column creation index p. Native p0,1, one labelled spin replica.
